content:
maria: proposal: surface per-route sampling rates + a small redaction confidence badge in Console. aim: faster debugging, minimal PII exposure.

sam: single stream or separate debug/audit streams?

maria: single stream, tag samples as debug (ephemeral) or audit (strict access + retention).

devon: defaults should be tiny. suggestion: debug 0.05%, audit 0.002%. per-route override only.
lisa: show confidence but not as a safety bypass. need to avoid false trust.
maria: Agreed. UI displays: redaction_mode, confidence (0.0-1.0) and a brief label ("email", "ssn-like"). confidence is informational only.

patrick: attachments/embeddings = no sampling by default. require tenant opt-in for file routes.
audit-bot: policy-alert: /v1/upload sensitivity=0.93 -> auto-opt-out.

maria: good. default: text-only routes get conservative sampling; file routes = opt-out.
sam: can we see a sample config to sync infra & product?

maria: example config snippet:

```yaml
route: /v1/completions
sampling:
  debug_rate: 0.0005   # 0.05% debug, visible in Console for 24h
  audit_rate: 0.00002  # 0.002% stored in audit with restricted access
redaction:
  mode: mask-first      # mask-first | token-hash | redact-all
  confidence_threshold: 0.88
  attachments: deny_by_default
```

devon: UX: inline label "sampling: 0.05% debug / 0.002% audit" + help tooltip. add redaction_confidence histogram in route telemetry.
lisa: viewing debug samples should require breakglass justification and create an audit entry with actor + reason. TTL 24h.
maria: yes. breakglass stored in audit log; debug view expires after 24h. audit samples follow retention policy for compliance customers.

patrick: add an org-level kill-switch to set debug_rate=0 globally to 0. show banner when enabled.
sam: infra will implement a global flag with priority over per-route settings. re-enable flow requires approval.
devon: add a cost estimator: projected token cost delta when adjusting the debug slider. use recent volume * avg tokens * sampling.
lisa: tie sampled examples into Redwood Optimize and run periodic regression checks for scrub accuracy. alert on spikes.

maria: next steps: I'll write an RFC and a tiny API + Console prototype. owner: @devon. please include list of auto-opt-out patterns (file uploads, embeddings, webhook-targeted routes).
sam: :thumbsup: also document tenant opt-in process and compliance caveats.
devon: will coordinate with infra for kill-switch + quota caps. will post PR links.
maria: thanks all, will add RFC link here when ready. :eyes:
